summary: Chen et al.’s Table S6 is accessible and lists 1,865 selected gene-by-subtype results across 34 neuronal subtypes. HypoExplorer estimates one food-deprived versus fed effect per gene across all hypothalamic cells pooled by mouse. The published subtype effects cannot validate that whole-hypothalamus contrast.

manualReview.summary: Table S6 reports fasting responses within neuronal subtypes. The registered track pools all hypothalamic cells by mouse.
manualReview.note: The deposited merged matrix and cluster assignments cover the same 14,437 cells. Their seven processed units correspond to the four fed and three food-deprived mice described in the supplemental procedures. The registered exploratory edgeR quasi-likelihood fit adjusts for batch and has one residual degree of freedom. Table S6 reports selected within-subtype MAST hurdle tests with mean expression by feeding condition, log2 fold change and raw P. Its 1,865 listed rows each name a neuronal subtype. The authors provide neither a pooled effect for this track nor a gene-level adjusted P column in Table S6. Whole-track effect concordance and inferential agreement remain unassessed.
reviewFlags: Averaging the selected subtype effects or treating the same gene in different subtypes as replicates would change the biological comparison.

verificationReview.reason: The publisher supplies the neuronal subtype DE list in Table S6. It covers the same feeding intervention but supplies no gene-level effect for the all-cell, mouse-level deprived_vs_fed contrast. The GEO files contain counts, normalized expression and cell assignments. An effect comparison or an inference comparison would require a pooled author result.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if the authors release gene-level food-deprived versus fed estimates covering all hypothalamic cells from the study mice, with the aggregation unit and model documented.
